messages.subject: Problem with while loop (or round?)
parts:
Can anyone see something that I'm missing with these two while loops?
I can't get them to give me the same response, even though it seems
they should. Maybe it's because of R's "interesting" way of rounding.
I want the first loop to stop when counter > 0.05, but it doesn't stop
until counter = 0.05. When I increase the numbers by a factor of 100 I
get the response I expect. Any ideas? Thanks. Earl Brown

> counter<-0.10
> while (counter>0.05) {
+ cat("counter is at ", counter, "\n", sep="")
+ counter<-counter-0.01
+ }
counter is at 0.1
counter is at 0.09
counter is at 0.08
counter is at 0.07
counter is at 0.06
counter is at 0.05
>
> counter<-10
> while (counter>5) {
+ cat("counter is at ", counter, "\n", sep="")
+ counter<-counter-1
+ }
counter is at 10
counter is at 9
counter is at 8
counter is at 7
counter is at 6
>
